_comment: The trick list's keycap recipes (T-491; HUD and menus, Decisions, 'Each trick shows the keys that make it'). Structure only: the texts come from tutorial_text.json. 'clip' is the recorded clip shown for the trick (game/art/tutorial/clips/<clip>_sheet.png). 'steps' are in order; step N's note is trick_recipe.<id>.stepN_note and its badge trick_recipe.<id>.stepN_badge. A step with 'keys' draws those keys as keycaps joined with +; a step with 'badge' true draws the badge word instead of keys. 'either' lists the keys that get a small /D tag (either turn key works). THREAD THE NEEDLE! has no recipe. T-543 added reverse_drift, aura and rail_grind (the detector's ids), with the texts of T-533.
